evening_peak.title: Diurnal Peak Concentration
evening_peak.sentence: Across Mumbai monitoring stations, PM2.5 concentrations typically peak at 08:00 with a median of 57.8 µg/m³, which is 15.1% higher than the overall median of 50.2 µg/m³.

calm_wind_episodes.title: Calm-Wind Stagnation Uplift
calm_wind_episodes.sentence: During calm-wind stagnation episodes (wind speed <= 4.8 km/h lasting at least 3 hours), average PM2.5 rises to 58.9 µg/m³ compared to 49.2 µg/m³ during ventilated periods (+19.7% difference across 3040 episode observations).

persistent_worst_stations.title: Persistent Worst Stations
persistent_worst_stations.sentence: Over the last 91 days, the stations with the most frequent Unhealthy air (>60 µg/m³) were Kherwadi_Bandra East, Mumbai - MPCB (46.7% of 1779 valid hours), Byculla, Mumbai - BMC (43.3% of 1599 valid hours), and Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai - MPCB (38.8% of 1749 valid hours).
